acl_policy.description: Default policy for newly connected devices: 'authorize' to allow, 'deny' to block, or 'unauthorize' to remove from authorization list.

state_dir.description: Directory where Bolt stores persistent device authorization state.

max_devices.description: Maximum number of devices to track; older entries are pruned if exceeded.

log_level.description: Verbosity of the daemon log output (none, error, warn, info, debug).

device_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a device response before marking it disconnected.

auto_auth_trusted.description: When enabled, automatically authorize devices that are cryptographically trusted (requires secure boot + signed kernel modules).

auto_auth_pci_bdfs.description: PCI BDF identifiers (e.g., '00:1f.0') of internal devices that should always be auto-authenticated.

auth_groups.description: System groups whose members may authorize/deny Thunderbolt devices via D-Bus.

auth_users.description: Additional individual users allowed to manage device authorization (supersedes groups).

udev_dir.description: Optional path to custom udev rules directory (leave empty to use bundled rules).

enable_legacy_enumeration.description: Enable fallback to legacy Thunderbolt enumeration (for older platforms missing ACPI support).
